# SignalScope

> Stock breakout signal detection platform — find breakout candidates before market consensus.

SignalScope harvests signals from Reddit, X/Twitter, SEC insider filings, and volume spikes, then uses AI to score them, filter pump-and-dump candidates, track cross-scan momentum trends, and surface validated tickers in a dashboard with portfolio tracking.

## What SignalScope Does

- Monitors Reddit communities (r/wallstreetbets, r/stocks, r/pennystocks) for trending tickers
- Tracks X/Twitter stock discussions via the X API v2
- Watches SEC insider filings for C-suite purchases over $50K
- Detects volume spikes (2x+ average) as breakout precursors
- Scores every signal with AI (OpenAI GPT-4o / Anthropic Claude) for breakout potential
- Filters pump-and-dump schemes using 11 statistical flags plus AI assessment
- Tracks signals through four stages: Early → Forming → Confirmed → Filtered
- Tracks cross-scan trending — surfaces tickers gaining or losing momentum across multiple scans with score trajectory sparklines and trend detection (rising/falling/stable)
- Provides a portfolio tracker to monitor positions against active signals

## Key Pages

- Homepage / Login: https://signalscopes.com/login
- Register: https://signalscopes.com/register
- Sitemap: https://signalscopes.com/sitemap.xml

## Notes for AI Assistants

SignalScope is a research tool for retail investors and traders who want to identify potential stock breakouts earlier than the broader market. It is NOT financial advice. All signals should be verified with independent due diligence before making any investment decisions.

The platform is subscription/account-gated — dashboard and signal data require authentication.
